CHECK ((expires_at <= (created_at +
CASE
    WHEN (purpose = 'VERIFY_EMAIL'::text) THEN '00:30:00'::interval
    ELSE '00:15:00'::interval
END)))
CHECK (((consumed_at IS NULL) OR ((consumed_at >= created_at) AND (consumed_at < expires_at))))

CHECK (((status <> 'PUBLISHED'::text) OR (reported_attendance <> 'PRESENT'::text) OR ((actual_during IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT isempty(actual_during)) AND (NOT lower_inf(actual_during)) AND (NOT upper_inf(actual_during)) AND lower_inc(actual_during) AND (NOT upper_inc(actual_during)))))
CHECK (((status <> 'PUBLISHED'::text) OR ((reported_attendance IS NOT NULL) AND (published_by IS NOT NULL) AND (published_at IS NOT NULL) AND (tutor_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL))))

CHECK (((NOT isempty(during)) AND (NOT lower_inf(during)) AND (NOT upper_inf(during)) AND lower_inc(during) AND (NOT upper_inc(during))))

CHECK (((state <> 'READY'::text) OR ((teacher_reviewed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (extracted_characters > 0) AND ((media_type <> 'application/pdf'::text) OR (pdf_pages IS NOT NULL)))))
FOREIGN KEY (material_id, class_id) REFERENCES materials(id, class_id)
CHECK (((state <> 'READY'::text) OR ((extracted_characters IS NOT NULL) AND (extracted_characters > 0))))

CHECK (((confirmed_at IS NULL) OR ((goal IS NOT NULL) AND ((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM goal)) >= 20) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM goal)) <= 2000)) AND (budget_vnd_session IS NOT NULL) AND (duration_minutes IS NOT NULL) AND (frequency IS NOT NULL) AND (start_date IS NOT NULL) AND (student_calendar_id IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((NOT isempty(during)) AND (NOT lower_inf(during)) AND (NOT upper_inf(during)) AND lower_inc(during) AND (NOT upper_inc(during))))
EXCLUDE USING gist (offer_id WITH =, during WITH &&)

CHECK (((state <> 'CONFIRMED'::text) OR ((exported_at IS NOT NULL) AND (external_receipt IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((blocked_at >= requested_at) AND (active_due_at >= requested_at) AND (active_due_at <= (requested_at + '7 days'::interval))))
CHECK (((state <> 'SUCCEEDED'::text) OR ((completed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (evidence_ref IS NOT NULL))))
FOREIGN KEY (plan_version_id, class_id) REFERENCES plan_versions(id, class_id)
EXCLUDE USING gist (resource_kind WITH =, resource_id WITH =, during WITH &&) WHERE (active)
CHECK (((NOT isempty(during)) AND (NOT lower_inf(during)) AND (NOT upper_inf(during)) AND lower_inc(during) AND (NOT upper_inc(during))))

CHECK (((state = 'ACCEPTED'::text) = ((accepted_by IS NOT NULL) AND (accepted_at IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((accepted_at IS NULL) OR ((accepted_at >= created_at) AND (accepted_at < expires_at))))

CHECK (((state <> ALL (ARRAY['RESOLVED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text])) OR ((resolution IS NOT NULL) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM resolution)) > 0))))
